d: Role Description This full-time, on-site Sales Executive role is based in Muscat. The Sales Executive will identify and pursue new business opportunities, build and manage a pipeline of prospects, and conduct client meetings and presentations to showcase the company’s media and digital marketing solutions. Daily activities include qualifying leads, preparing proposals and quotations, negotiating contracts, and following up to ensure timely closing of deals and achievement of sales targets. The role also involves maintaining strong relationships with existing clients, coordinating with internal teams to align solutions with client needs, and tracking market trends and competitor activities. The Sales Executive will report on sales performance, forecast revenue, and support the development of sales strategies to expand Digital Gulf Media’s presence across the Gulf.
q: li
Strong sales and business development skills, including lead generation, prospecting, and closing deals.
li
Ability to build and maintain client relationships, with a focus on consultative selling and customer satisfaction.
li
Understanding of media, advertising, and digital marketing services, and ability to explain these solutions clearly to clients.
li
Solid communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with proficiency in written and spoken English; Arabic language skills are an advantage.
li
Comfort with using CRM tools, sales reporting systems, and basic office software to manage pipelines and track performance.
li
Proven ability to work toward targets, manage time effectively, and collaborate with creative and marketing teams.
li
Previous experience in sales within media, marketing, or related industries is preferred.
li
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

r: Lead daily operations: Manage outlet operations, including guest service standards, product quality, inventory, cost controls, profitability, marketing, budgeting, and enforcing policies and procedures
Deliver exceptional guest experiences: Monitor service and product quality, assess guest satisfaction, address issues, and identify opportunities to continuously improve the dining experience

Inspire and develop the team: Supervise, coach, and mentor team members; conduct performance evaluations, provide professional development opportunities, and recognize achievements to build, retain, and engage a high-performing team
Drive revenue growth: Implement innovative marketing strategies, up-selling techniques, and promotional initiatives to maximize food and beverage sales and profitability
Recruit and onboard talent: Lead hiring efforts, conduct interviews, and train new team members to maintain high service standards and operational excellence
Uphold regulatory standards: Maintain compliance with health, safety, sanitation, and alcohol awareness regulations, ensuring the highest standards of guest and team member wellbeing
